items.title: James Hunter interviewed by Monk Rowe, Boston, Massachusetts, July 25, 2018
items.q: Well in Gabe’s case, Gabe Roth, he says you can do anything on digital that you can do on analog, he just prefers the process.

ctx.x: Yeah. People tend to get — when they have all this gear they can use you feel like you want to use it.

Yeah. Well in Gabe’s case, Gabe Roth, he says you can do anything on digital that you can do on analog, he just prefers the process. He just enjoys it more, you know, the editing and everything. He says you can get all the effects and sounds. His whole thing is mic placement, you know, where you put the mic and what mic to use. That’s how you get the sound.
A British journalist I met reminded me of the phrase “across the pond.”
